data: What is the accuracy of the FastText(dict) model in the de-->es plot with all parallel sentences?

The FastText(dict) model is represented by the dashed green line in the de→es plot. The legend indicates that the FastText(dict) model achieves an accuracy of approximately 57.45% when using 1M parallel sentences. Therefore, the accuracy of the FastText(dict) model in the de→es plot with all parallel sentences is approximately 57.45%.
